statistics.training_seed_level_limitation: Only three training seeds are available; hierarchical intervals are descriptive and do not support high-precision population inference about training-initialization variability.

primary_endpoints: load false-entry probability vs load magnitude

current_sensor_boundary.claim_boundary: quantifies dependence on the current channel; no current-sensor fault-tolerance claim is permitted

operating_envelope.load_rule: do not classify SUPPORTED/LIMITED/UNSUPPORTED; report false-entry risk, substitution, tracking penalty and uncertainty
operating_envelope.current_rule: outside the V3 single-fault support claim; report degradation/safety and do not claim current-sensor fault tolerance

seed_provenance_conclusion: No pre-study use of any selected simulation seed was found outside the new final_robustness namespace.
